item.title: PDP reacts to Fubara's defection to APC: "Don't blame us"
item.description: The PDP has stirred fresh controversies following its reaction to the allegation made by Governor Siminalayi Fubara following his defection to the ruling APC.

item.title: Asian stocks in retreat as traders eye Fed decision, tech earnings
item.description: Asian markets retreated Wednesday following a tepid day on Wall Street as investors bided their time ahead of a highly anticipated Federal Reserve policy announcement later in the day.

item.title: Nepal faces economic fallout of September protest
item.description: When Nepal's government was toppled in September after deadly youth-led protests against economic stagnation and corruption, many in the impoverished country hoped for a period of meaningful political change. Protests, initially triggered by anger over a brief government ban on social media, were spearheaded by protesters under the loose "Gen Z" umbrella.

item.title: Oil-rich UAE turns to AI to grease economy
item.description: Deep in the Abu Dhabi desert, a vast AI campus a quarter the size of Paris is starting to emerge, the oil-rich UAE's boldest bet yet on technology it hopes will help transform its economy. Now, the UAE is hoping that AI can help fill the gap when oil demand inevitably wanes.

item.title: Benin Republic, other African countries Nigerian soldiers have five guns
item.description: The full list of African countries Nigeria has launch military operation following its recent stopping of military take over in the Republic Benin has been compiled.

item.title: China surplus pushing EU to take 'offensive' trade measures: business lobby
item.description: China's mammoth trade surplus with Europe as well as challenges faced by foreign firms in the country are incentivising Brussels to adopt more "offensive" policies, a business lobby warned Wednesday.

item.title: Primate Ayodele releases prophecies, speaks on 'sacking' Tinubu
item.description: Primate Elijah Ayodele has released prophecies. The cleric spoke on the possibility of sacking President Bola Ahmed Tinubu in the 2027 elections.

item.title: Full list: PDP governors who resigned to join APC in 2025 and their reasons
item.description: The full list of the PDP governors who have dumped the party to join the APC in the 2025 have been compiled and their different reasons were also stated.

item.title: Benin Coup: Soyinka says Tinubu should have sent his son instead of fighter jets, explains why in trending video
item.description: Prof. Wole Soyinka, in a viral video, mocked President Bola Tinubu’s response to the Benin coup attempt, saying he should have sent his son instead of fighter jets.

item.title: Osun Governor Adeleke leaves PDP, rejects APC, announces new party
item.description: Ademola Adeleke, governor of Osun state, has snubbed the ruling APC after resigning from the PDP. Adeleke officially announced his new party on Tuesday.
